question: Should this PR require exact-head live WhatsApp proof for the rewritten gateway and standalone ownership paths, or may the earlier linked-account result plus current mock coverage be explicitly accepted?
rationale: The central query worked in an earlier live implementation, but the maintained head materially rewrites socket ownership, inbound-consumer suppression, credential draining, and shutdown; only a maintainer can authorize treating the earlier result as sufficient for this exact head.

options.title: Require exact-head live proof
options.body: Run the maintained head with a linked account and capture redacted output for gateway reuse, standalone lookup, and clean gateway recovery before merge.

options.title: Explicitly override proof
options.body: Accept the earlier linked-account result plus current tests as sufficient and record a maintainer proof override for this head.

options.title: Pause for a WhatsApp environment
options.body: Keep the PR open until a suitable linked-account environment can exercise the rewritten lifecycle safely.

recommendation.title: Require exact-head live proof
recommendation.body: Run the maintained head with a linked account and capture redacted output for gateway reuse, standalone lookup, and clean gateway recovery before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Owns the maintained rewrite and is best positioned to decide whether its prior live evidence is sufficient for the new lifecycle implementation.
